description: An actual scoped \(L^E\)-formula is equality-free when no logical equality constructor occurs; relation atoms, falsity, implication and quantifiers are allowed.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.EqualityFree.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w} {n : ℕ} :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Extended L).BoundedFormula α n → Prop
